# Factions
Every job belongs to a faction, and the factions do not get along. Their histories, ranks, culture and standing orders are in the lore book. This page lists where to find them.
## Who you can play
- [lorelink="TSFMC" link="TSFMC_Entry"]: the Federation's marines. Their [lorelink="S.O.P." link="TSFMC_SOP"] says how marines are expected to act. - [lorelink="PDV" link="PDV_Entry"]: the Phaethon Dynasty Vanguard. Read their [lorelink="standing orders" link="WFPdvStandingOrders"] for the ceasefire. - [lorelink="Caelestinus" link="Caelestinus"]: the neutral station staff, and the [lorelink="judges" link="WFLoreJudges"] who guard it. - [lorelink="USSP" link="USSP_Entry"]: what is left of the Union. - [lorelink="Viper Group" link="Viper_Group"] and [lorelink="Mieyo Manufacturing" link="MMC"]: hired guns and the company that sells to everyone. - [lorelink="Astraeus Solar Federation" link="WFAsf"]: the envoys at Lantern Post.
## Who will shoot at you
- [lorelink="The Ashfall Reavers" link="WFLoreReavers"]: raiders with strongholds. - [lorelink="The ADS" link="WFLoreAds"]: the machines. How to handle them is under [textlink="ADS" link="WFAds"] below.
The cold war rules themselves are in the server rules, not the lore book. Breaking an in-character order gets you trouble from your officers. Breaking a rule gets you trouble from the admins.
